info.title: CF Meet Platform Access internal API
info.description: Internal HTTP surface of services/platform-access, the shared identity authority (Part IV Workstream B, ADR 0032): GET /health and /ready (public, no data) and the service-authenticated /internal/v1 API. Every /internal/v1 path — including unknown ones — requires a valid service token (cfmeet.platform.internal-http) and the operation's permission from Platform Access's trust bundle; a customer credential is never accepted in its place. Request bodies are limited to 64 KiB. Messages are defined by cfmeet.platform-access.identity. Consumers: Calling (authenticate, resolve / register principals, read identity and the change feed), Meeting Service (first-party principal ensure, Part V H §104), Messaging (authenticate, resolve, read identity), Numbering (authenticate, resolve, read identity), the operator console (administration). 1.4.0: Developer Platform service-account delegation (Part VI §50) — /internal/v1/delegation/environments/{environmentId}/service-accounts[/{serviceAccountId}[/status]] (create, list, read, suspend / resume; non-production environments only; no credential operation). 1.5.0 (Part VI §54 / §55): delegated credential self-service (issue / list / get / rotate / revoke / suspend / resume), reversible credential suspension (credential_suspended), delegated STANDARD scope grants and withdrawals, production-environment activation for approved requests and delegated live telecom of activated PRODUCTION environments. 1.6.0 (Blueprint Section 7, ADR 0058): governed FIRST_PARTY organization scopes for the Organizations Service only (platform-identity.provision-first-party) — PUT / GET /internal/v1/organization-scopes/{organizationRef}/{capability} (idempotent create-or-return and read-back of the organization's dedicated FIRST_PARTY tenant, first-party application and PRODUCTION-kind environment) and POST .../status (tenant suspension / resumption); never credentials, scope grants or EXTERNAL tenants. 1.7.0 (Blueprint Section 15): GET /internal/v1/admin/audit (operator-only, paginated read of the append-only operator audit trail, PLT-009); POST /internal/v1/delegation/tenants/{tenantId}/display-name (organization rename propagation to EXTERNAL tenants, audited TENANT_RENAMED, ORG-013); GET /internal/v1/delegation/tenant-slugs/{slug} (organization-creation reconciliation, ORG-014); credential views add lastAuthenticatedAt (debounced last successful authentication, null when never seen) and expiringSoon (stops authenticating within 14 days, PLT-008). 1.8.0 (Blueprint Section 14, ACC-010): POST /internal/v1/principals/account-status — the first-party account authority (platform-principal.ensure) mirrors an account's current status onto its NATIVE_CF_USER principal (ACTIVE / SUSPENDED / DEACTIVATED; idempotent; never creates or revives a tombstoned principal). 1.9.0 (ADR 0058 Amendment A2): automatic organization service bindings for the Organizations Service (platform-identity.bind-organization-services): PUT / GET / DELETE /internal/v1/organization-scopes/{organizationRef}/{capability}/service-bindings/{service} and POST …/rotate — the organization's Calling / Messaging service account and credential inside its own FIRST_PARTY triple with a closed scope set; the secret is never returned. 1.10.0 (ADR 0062, CF Meet Platform "Build"; every operation behind a default-off flag, off: 404 NOT_FOUND): the partner Users API for the Developer Console (platform-end-users.delegate, CF-Forwarded-Credential-Id re-verified live, EXTERNAL environments only) — POST / GET /internal/v1/end-users, GET / PATCH / DELETE /internal/v1/end-users/{userId}, POST …/revoke-sessions, user-token minting POST /internal/v1/end-users/{userId}/tokens and POST /internal/v1/end-users/tokens (scope user_tokens.issue), and the console read GET /internal/v1/delegation/environments/{environmentId}/end-users; user-token verification POST /internal/v1/user-tokens/verify and GET /internal/v1/user-tokens/keys (platform-user-token.verify); allowed websites GET /internal/v1/environment-origins (change feed), GET /internal/v1/environments/{environmentId}/origins (platform-environment-origins.read) and GET / PUT /internal/v1/delegation/environments/{environmentId}/allowed-origins (platform-identity.delegate); partner meeting principals POST /internal/v1/principals/ensure-meeting-platform (platform-principal.ensure-meeting-platform). New error codes SCOPE_REQUIRED, LIMIT_EXCEEDED, RATE_LIMITED, USER_TOKEN_INVALID, USER_TOKEN_EXPIRED, USER_TOKEN_REVOKED.

cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer <service token> (cfmeet.platform.internal-http). Permissions come only from Platform Access's trust bundle.

CfDelegatedActor.name: X-CF-Delegated-Actor
CfDelegatedActor.description: The acting party: `u-<32 lowercase hex>` (a human member the Developer Platform authorized) `s-<32 lowercase hex>` (the service account of a scoped machine credential) or `o-<32 lowercase hex>` (a Developer Platform operator command); recorded as operator `devplat.<actor>` in the append-only audit.

CfForwardedCredentialId.name: CF-Forwarded-Credential-Id
CfForwardedCredentialId.description: ADR 0062: the id of the API credential the API Gateway authenticated (taken by the Developer Console from its signed delegated context). Platform Access re-verifies it LIVE (revocation, expiry, suspension, service account, current scopes); it is the ONLY source of the environment. When the service token also carries a delegated platform context, its credential and scope must match.

OrganizationScope.description: The governed FIRST_PARTY scope of one first-party organization (ids, statuses and classification only).

verified.description: FIRST_PARTY tenant with the reserved slug owning the application owning a PRODUCTION environment.

active.description: Tenant, application and environment are all ACTIVE.

OrganizationServiceBinding.description: The Calling / Messaging service account and credential Platform Access provisioned for one first-party organization inside its own FIRST_PARTY triple (ADR 0058 Amendment A2). Ids, statuses and scopes only — never a secret, verifier, public id or masked credential.

authenticates.description: Whether authentication would accept the credential now (credential state, service account and the whole triple ACTIVE, binding not revoked).

EndUser.description: ADR 0062: a partner user (an EXTERNAL_APPLICATION_PRINCIPAL principal of the credential's environment) and its profile.

externalId.description: The partner's opaque id (never a telephone number or SIP address).

EndUserPage.description: A page of visible (not deleted) partner users in creation order.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

externalId.description: 1-128 printable ASCII characters without spaces; telephone numbers, tel: / sip: URIs and the reserved tombstoned: prefix are refused.

displayName.description: 1-64 characters, no control characters; null clears it.

imageUrl.description: An https:// URL of at most 512 characters; null clears it.

displayName.description: 1-64 characters, no control characters; null clears it.

imageUrl.description: An https:// URL of at most 512 characters; null clears it.

tokensNotBefore.description: User tokens issued before this instant are revoked (the next whole second after the call).

UserTokenGrants.description: Grants of a CF Meet user token. Every part is optional in requests and always present in responses. Required credential scopes: msg:read messages.read, msg:send messages.send, call:receive calls.write, mtg meetings.write.

token.description: Returned once; never stored or logged by Platform Access.

externalId.description: 1-128 printable ASCII characters without spaces; telephone numbers, tel: / sip: URIs and the reserved tombstoned: prefix are refused.

displayName.description: 1-64 characters, no control characters; null clears it.

imageUrl.description: An https:// URL of at most 512 characters; null clears it.

token.description: Returned once; never stored or logged by Platform Access.

VerifyUserTokenResult.description: A valid user token: its scope, the user and the EFFECTIVE grants (claimed grants intersected with the minting credential's current scopes). Consumers may cache it for at most 30 s, keyed by tokenId.

x.description: Raw public key, base64url without padding.

status.description: RETIRED: tokens it signed are USER_TOKEN_REVOKED.

SetEnvironmentOriginsRequest.description: At most 20 exact origins scheme://host[:port]: lowercase host, no path / query / fragment / user info / wildcard, no default port; https only, except http://localhost[:port] and http://127.0.0.1[:port] (SANDBOX and TEST environments only; a PRODUCTION environment never lists a loopback host). Duplicates are dropped.

EnvironmentOriginFeed.description: The allowed-websites change feed: one item per change (origin list or effective status), carrying the environment's LATEST state.

environmentStatus.description: ACTIVE when the environment, its application and its tenant are ACTIVE.

EnsureMeetingPlatformPrincipalRequest.description: Exactly one of two combinations: BOT_OR_SERVICE with `cfmeet:meeting-system`, or TEMPORARY_EXTERNAL_PARTICIPANT with `meeting-participant:<lowercase hyphenated uuid>`.

get.description: Liveness.
Readiness: database reachable and no migration pending (counts and versions only).

post.description: Validate a presented customer credential and return its trusted authority chain (or the rejection reason and any throttle). The presented value is never logged or stored. Permission: `platform-credential.authenticate`.

get.description: Status, expiry and revocation of a credential of the delegated scope (no secret, no verifier). Permission: `platform-identity.read`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

post.description: Re-evaluate NOW whether the credential of the delegated scope may perform an operation needing the given scopes (optionally for a principal). Permission: `platform-identity.read`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

get.description: The trusted context of the caller's delegated scope: tenant, application, environment, service account and authority mode. Permission: `platform-identity.read`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

post.description: A page of the identity change feed after the cursor (consumer projections). POST because internal requests carry no query strings. Permission: `platform-identity.read`.

get.description: Receipt of an operator-imported identity bundle (hand-off verification by the previous authority). Permission: `platform-identity.read`.
The server-authoritative scope registry (Calling, Numbering and SMS scopes; trust levels). Permission: `platform-identity.read`.

post.description: Resolve principal references inside the delegated scope only. Permission: `platform-principal.resolve`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

Get or create the TELEPHONE_ENDPOINT principal of a protected public party (by ContactReference, never a number). Idempotent. Permission: `platform-principal.register`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token (cfmeet.platform.delegated-platform-context); its tenant / application are re-validated here and never trusted on their own.

Part V H §104: get or create the NATIVE_CF_USER / TEMPORARY_EXTERNAL_PARTICIPANT principal of an account the first-party login authority (Meeting Service) authenticated itself. Idempotent. Permission: `platform-principal.ensure`. Requires the delegated platform context signed into the caller's service token; it must be a FIRST_PARTY tenant at FULL authority (EXTERNAL → POLICY_VIOLATION, suspended chain or principal → INVALID_STATE).

post.summary: Mirror a first-party account status onto its principal
post.description: Blueprint v1.0 Section 14 (ACC-010). The first-party account authority (the Meeting Service, permission platform-principal.ensure, signed delegated context of a FULL-authority FIRST_PARTY tenant) sets the NATIVE_CF_USER principal of externalReference to the account's CURRENT status: ACTIVE, SUSPENDED or DEACTIVATED. Idempotent (changed=false when already so). Never creates a principal (unknown reference: NOT_FOUND) and never changes a tombstoned one (INVALID_STATE).
Tombstone a principal for good (audited with the named human operator). Idempotent. Permission: `platform-principal.register`.

Part VI §51: the CURRENT authority chain of the API credential the API Gateway authenticated, for a receiving domain service. The credential id is taken only from the signed delegated context (`initiating_credential_id`) and must belong exactly to the delegated tenant / application / environment / service account; revocation, expiry, supersession, suspension and effective scopes are evaluated now. No secret is presented. Permission: `platform-credential.authenticate`.

put.summary: Create, return or renew an organization's service binding
put.description: Idempotent on the path (ADR 0058 Amendment A2). The first call, in ONE transaction, grants the service's closed scope set to the organization's first-party application, creates the service account in the organization's PRODUCTION environment, issues a credential with exactly those scopes and records the binding; it answers 201. Later calls answer 200 with the same ids, except that a credential that no longer authenticates (expired, revoked, superseded), expires within 30 days or carries other scopes is replaced for the same service account (predecessor revoked, revision + 1). Concurrent calls serialize. 404 when the organization scope was never provisioned; 409 when the tenant / application / environment is not ACTIVE, the binding was revoked, its credential is suspended, or a service account with the reserved name exists outside the binding registry (never adopted). Every committed change writes the operator audit (SCOPE_GRANTED, SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CREATED, CREDENTIAL_CREATED / CREDENTIAL_ROTATED / CREDENTIAL_REVOKED) with detail.organizationRef and detail.service. Permission `platform-identity.bind-organization-services` (grantable to cfmeet.organizations only) and the authenticated cfmeet.organizations identity; any other caller is INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. The credential secret is never returned (it is discarded at issuance; only its verifier is stored).

post.description: Creates the partner user `externalId` of the forwarded credential's environment (201), or returns the existing one (200; idempotent on externalId; given profile fields are applied). Audited (PRINCIPAL_REGISTERED / PRINCIPAL_PROFILE_SET). Developer Console only: permission `platform-end-users.delegate`; the `CF-Forwarded-Credential-Id` credential is re-verified live and is the only source of the environment (no longer authenticating or not matching the signed delegated context: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_INVALID; header missing: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED); its tenant must be EXTERNAL (POLICY_VIOLATION) and its chain ACTIVE (INVALID_STATE). A user of another environment is NOT_FOUND. Behind PLATFORM_ACCESS_END_USERS_ENABLED (off: 404 NOT_FOUND).
